title: A research job reclaimed after a restart reads the paid Apify run it started, and a job lost twice stops
steps: S1: restart during a paid Apify run; the next holder claims the job.
S3: a job whose lease ran out twice.
expect: S1: the recorded run is read; one run started.
S3: failed with its reason, not reclaimed.

selectors.code: vendor domain/apify.mjs onRun, opportunities executor.js/place-executor.js, store.js claimJob

evidence: Review 19/10/2026: a reclaim paid for a second Apify run; claimJob had no cap
fence: Run id checkpointed before waiting; reclaim cap

tests: a job whose lease ran out twice is not reclaimed a third time: it fails with its reason
a restart during a paid Apify run: the next holder reads the recorded run instead of starting another
a restart during a place job’s paid Apify run: the next holder reads the recorded run, one reservation
